lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Three lines on the posterior mid-torso terminate approximately 150 pixels above the ventral line, failing to cross the lower boundary of the torso mass.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 4 high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower haunch of the hind leg with a density of roughly one spot per 30x30 pixel area.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the upper hind limb align horizontally to form a semi-linear geometric segment.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Spiral-lyrate curvature; the horns emerge at a roughly 45-degree angle from the skull before curving inward and then upward at the tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The estimated pixel distance between terminal tips is approximately 1.4 times the width of a single horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping comprises approximately 10% of the total visible vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible white chevron between the eyes, two distinct white spots on the cheek/jaw area, and white banding on the lower portions of all four limbs.
